contactCallback.when: After HP_World_Step and the plugin sync. getLinearVelocity inside the callback is the post-step velocity.
contactCallback.observable: Body getCollisionObservable receives COLLISION_STARTED and COLLISION_CONTINUED. COLLISION_FINISHED is not delivered on this observable.
contactCallback.pointAndNormal: Reused Vector3 internals. The runtime copies x, y, and z during the callback.
contactCallback.impulse: Scalar, shared by both bodies. The first STARTED impulse often understates a resolved bounce. The larger impulse arrives on a CONTINUED callback one frame later.
contactCallback.preStep: The runtime copies getLinearVelocity into flight.acousticIncoming at the start of beforeStep, then the contact adapter dots that copy with the callback normal.
contactCallback.liveGain: Fixed from the opening callback. Later callbacks inside the 5/120 s hold only increment the callback count.
